Dream 2026-11-22 linked 3 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-27 · retells · "As a repo grows, it should evolve in a consistent manner automatically, with only significant redesigns coming up for PR." (Settled navigation stays stable; it grows consistently and only significant redesigns come up for PR (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "How do we structure repositories so that they are navigable?" (Navigability is semantic integrity; memory is layered and temporal; the dream cycle builds long-term memory by testing against scenarios (2026-10-27))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "So as long as we know where the boundaries came from, then dream boundaries are valid." (Simple domains lack clarity to be useful; cells are relative to a boundary, divide and repeat; dream boundaries are valid if we know where they came from; cluster may stay a name for a boundary with a function (2026-11-07))
